headline: 9 contract addresses catalogued across 9 chains (Bitlayer, Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Plume, Ink, Plasma, Sui, Starknet, Solana); proxy admin and owner addresses undiscovered due to explorer access failures.

findings.text: D1: btrscan.com (canonical Bitlayer explorer) returned HTTP error ('We're sorry') blocking direct contract inspection; etherscan.io fetch for the Ethereum deployment also failed at network level. No name-tag search results obtained from on-chain explorers. Ethereum address 0x2cd3CdB3bd68Eea0d3BE81DA707bC0c8743D7335 confirmed by Etherscan snippet in search results as 'Bitlayer: YBTC.B Token'.

D2: Official contract addresses page fetched at https://docs.bitlayer.org/docs/YBTCFamily/YBTC.B/introduction/ — lists 10 chain deployments. Primary origin token is on Bitlayer at 0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335; same EVM address reused on Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Plume, Ink, Plasma. Sui and Starknet and Solana have distinct non-EVM addresses. Bitlayer WBTC (wrapped BTC input asset) at 0xff204e2681a6fa0e2c3fade68a1b28fb90e4fc5f also identified from docs text.
D3: No audit_links provided in protocol context; no audit links found in fetched docs pages. Cannot surface in-scope addresses from audits.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/bitlayer-org referenced on website and docs. No specific deployment artifact files (broadcast/run-latest.json, deployments/*.json) were fetched due to remaining fetch budget; no pinned commit SHA obtained.

D5: Protocol.chains lists only 'Bitlayer' but docs confirm cross-chain deployment on Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Plume, Ink, Plasma, Sui, Starknet, Solana. Each EVM chain uses same address 0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335 per official docs. Non-EVM (Sui, Starknet, Solana) use distinct addresses. All recorded in admin_addresses with chain-specific entries.
D6: No factory contracts identified. YBTC.B is a single token contract + vault system; no pool enumeration needed.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: primary contract is 'token' (ERC4626 wrapped BTC); supporting asset is 'token' (WBTC/Bitlayer native wrapped BTC). Proxy admin and owner roles are unknown — on-chain reads blocked.
D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched docs URL. No address added from snippet-only sightings without a verifiable fetch.

rationale.verdict: Walked the official Bitlayer docs contract-address page (D2) and website (D1 partial), yielding 10 address entries across 10 chains (9 unique contract addresses). On-chain verification was blocked: btrscan.com returned an error, etherscan.io fetch failed, and Bitlayer chainId 200901 is unsupported by DeFiPunkd read API. Proxy admin and owner addresses remain undiscovered. Grade is unknown — grading_basis is mixed (docs fetch succeeded; on-chain fetch failed).

evidence.shows: Bitlayer official website confirms GitHub at https://github.com/bitlayer-org, btrscan.com as block explorer, and docs at docs.bitlayer.org. Lists YBTC TVL $3M+ and references YBTC product.

Official YBTC.B introduction page listing all contract addresses per chain: Bitlayer 0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335, Ethereum same address, BSC same address, Avalanche same address, Plume same address, Ink same address, Plasma same address, Sui 0xa03ab7eee2c8e97111977b77374eaf6324ba617e7027382228350db08469189e::ybtc::YBTC, Starknet 0x02cab84694e1be6af2ce65b1ae28a76009e8ec99ec4bc17047386abf20cbb688, Solana 3VcKofugG1SPJmjuiEZCJL5mk1JkyqGZ19ByeMWXVWfK. Also identifies WBTC (Bitlayer wrapped BTC input token) at 0xff204e2681a6fa0e2c3fade68a1b28fb90e4fc5f. Confirms ERC1967 upgradeable proxy (V2, ERC4626 standard). Token decimals: 8.

protocol_metadata.about: YBTC.B is a wrapped ERC4626 token representing Bitlayer's native BTC (a Bitcoin Layer 2 asset), designed as a universal cross-chain liquidity standard for EVM and non-EVM networks. Users deposit native BTC via Bitlayer's official bridge to mint YBTC.B 1:1, or acquire it on DEXs across supported chains. YBTC.B can be deposited into DeFi and CeDeFi Vault products to earn BTC-denominated yield through strategies including LP farming, lending, and structured fixed-income products. The token is originally minted on Bitlayer and bridged to other chains primarily via Chainlink CCIP, maintaining consistent EVM address 0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335 across EVM-compatible deployments.
